args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Fix `parseStatement` in `src/ingest/parser.ts` to properly handle multiple trailing newlines or empty lines at the end of statement files instead of popping only a single empty line, preventing spurious `IngestError` ("errors.rowShape") when parsing files with trailing blank lines.
args.title: Fix parser handling of trailing empty lines in statements

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

`parseStatement` in `src/ingest/parser.ts` only pops a single trailing empty line, causing files with multiple trailing newlines or blank lines at the end to attempt parsing empty lines as transaction rows and throwing an `IngestError`.
